messages.subject: WP — P Marsden — response to your offer
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Without prejudice. Our client will not accept £95,000. We are instructed to seek £115,000 ex gratia, a £2,500 fee contribution, and a reduction of the non-compete to 6 months. Schedule of loss attached separately. He is, however, prepared to reaffirm the customer covenants. Let's try to bridge the gap.

Regards,
Alistair Whitlock
Partner, Pemberton Rowe LLP
5 Temple Row, Birmingham B2 5LG

messages.snippet: Alistair, Without prejudice. £115k is not available — £95,000 already reflects a substantial premium
messages.subject: RE: WP — P Marsden — response to your offer
messages.plaintextBody:
Alistair,

Without prejudice. £115k is not available — £95,000 already reflects a substantial premium over the statutory position and our risk analysis. We can hold the £1,500 fee contribution and £5,000 outplacement. On covenants we will recut the non-compete to 9 months (garden leave set off); the customer covenants stay at 12 months. If your client accepts the package at £95,000 ex gratia we have a deal and I'll circulate a draft agreement.

Kind regards,
Sarah

Sarah Whitfield | Partner
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0100
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
